subject: Hedging, barbells, and smart strategies for a volatile market
body_text:
96 
 Your August podcast roundup is here–listen now. August Podcast Roundup 

  

 
 We covered a broad range of key topics this month, from smart barbell pairings to retirement strategies, passive investing, and the latest insights for tech. Want the full story? Explore it all in the latest sessions of the Investing Experts Podcast . 
 

 
   Hedging Exposure In This Volatile Market
 

 
 Guest: Michael Kramer, Founder & Investing Group Leader of Reading the Markets
 

 
 Market fluctuation has become the norm, driven by implied volatility, option positioning, and liquidity flows instead of traditional macroeconomic data. Mott Capital Investment Founder Michael Kramer explores this current landscape, focusing on undervalued sectors like healthcare and select software stocks. He also explains why recent over-the-top S&P 500 performance can be misleading. 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   Steven Cress Picks Lockheed Martin + Sandisk For Balance And Diversification, Growth And Income
 

 
 Guest: Steven Cress, VP of Seeking Alpha’s Quantitative Strategy 
 

 
 In this insightful update, Seeking Alpha’s Steven Cress shares two picks to help investors maximize diversification and combat recent market volatility. Find out why Steven likes pairing Lockheed Martin and Sandisk as part of a trusted barbell strategy and how the two stocks working together can offer both strong growth potential and attractive income generation.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   Make Retirement Awesome Again With Jared Dillian 

 
 Guest: Jared Dillian, Author, Investor, and Founder of Jared Dillian Money 
 

 
 In today’s market, traditional all-stock portfolios can expose investors to severe drawdowns and behavioral pitfalls. In his upcoming book, The Awesome Portfolio, author Jared Dillian advocates a balanced allocation across stocks, bonds, cash, gold, and real estate for lower drawdowns and higher risk efficiency. Find out why he believes this kind of diversification can enhance long-term compounding, plus learn why he’s bullish on bonds, bearish on the USD, and pulling back on energy. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   What's Up With Tech?
 

 
 Guest: Sara Awad, Founder and Investing Group Leader of Tech Contrarians 
 

 
 This has been a tough year for tech. In this timely podcast, Sara Awad from Tech Contrarians highlights some challenges tech has seen in 2026 and talks about where investors should focus first. Find out why she believes semiconductor stocks still face further downside despite their potential, and why memory names (such as Micron) pose a high risk in H2. What about AI? We dig into the growing bubble too.
